trigger: Local pickup candidate passes preliminary range/size checks; prediction only
localOrRemote: Local player only; remote receives nothing from prediction
confirmationRequirement: no reward commit; local provisional state only; cancel on rejection
audio: No reward/acquisition sound; optional near-silent non-success tick only if usability-tested
visual: Muted ghost/outline or brief pending marker, distinct from confirmed effect; reversible
haptic: None by default; never celebrate provisional gain
coalesce: Per item ID/generation; replace stale prediction; don't stack repeats
poolBudgetProposal: Share transient VFX pool; one pending marker per local object; budget provisional
lowFXMustRetain: Keep an accessible pending/uncertain marker where needed; never show score/size award as confirmed
licenseNeeds: No external SFX/VFX yet; any eventual asset needs provenance and licenseManifestId

trigger: Authority confirms unique item claim and confirmed gain
localOrRemote: Local owner: richer close-range cue; remote players: sparse nearby summary only
confirmationRequirement: confirmed ledger result with item generation/commit sequence; only then success cue
audio: Short material-class pickup one-shot; coalesce small items; local/remote mix differs
visual: Short attachment cue; remote only if nearby/significant; no duplicate per representation
haptic: Optional light pulse only for meaningful confirmed pickup; user-toggleable
coalesce: Batch small pickups by short time window/material; one event per item commit key
poolBudgetProposal: At most one pickup burst per client per coalesce window; counts are tuning proposals
lowFXMustRetain: Confirmed result/score state; disabled detail cannot conceal whether item is confirmed if currently visible
licenseNeeds: Record source/author/license for each sound and visual; paid-world redistribution reviewed

trigger: Authority rejects/another player wins/local prediction invalidated
localOrRemote: Local claimant gets correction; remote winner may receive confirmed event instead
confirmationRequirement: explicit rejection/result state; no success consequence
audio: Never play reward sound; optional neutral cancel click only if distinct
visual: Clear/return speculative item with neutral cancel marker; never show it attached/awarded
coalesce: Collapse duplicate rejection by (round,item,generation,request); suppress stale results
poolBudgetProposal: No dedicated transient allocation; reuse pending-marker slot
lowFXMustRetain: Reject/pending result must stay distinguishable from confirmed award in UI/state; no false score
licenseNeeds: Own neutral UI/audio asset or approved licensed source; no borrowed game feedback

trigger: Confirmed volume crosses configured gameplay tier
localOrRemote: Local player and nearby remote observers; exact detail local
confirmationRequirement: confirmed volume/tier only; prediction may not announce unlock
audio: One short tier accent, coalesced if multiple thresholds in same commit
visual: Persistent size/tier label or shape cue; optional brief accent
coalesce: One per resulting tier; merge multiple crossings from one commit into final tier
poolBudgetProposal: One tier accent slot; persistent state uses HUD, not transient pool
lowFXMustRetain: Current confirmed tier/status remains available in lowFX; no decorative effect required
licenseNeeds: Original composition/visual only or individually reviewed licensed assets; no game-derived motif

trigger: Previously attached item becomes visually occluded/recycled by core growth
localOrRemote: Local presentation; remote summary only if attachment state changes
confirmationRequirement: confirmed attachment/volume drives presentation; not a new gain
audio: None by default; no extra reward sound
visual: Blend/fade item into core, local detail; remote proxy may omit it
coalesce: One reconciliation per ball revision; don't play per hidden renderer
poolBudgetProposal: Reuse attachment presentation slots; no new network event for purely local hiding
lowFXMustRetain: Confirmed mass/score state unaffected; no gameplay status hidden by lowFX
licenseNeeds: No new asset required; any dissolve effect still needs asset provenance

trigger: Authoritative refresh state announces pickup availability/next refresh
localOrRemote: Shared state; visible to affected nearby/local users
confirmationRequirement: authoritative spawn generation and schedule; no client-invented spawn
audio: Brief neutral availability cue, not repeated globally
visual: World marker / timer for relevant point; no sudden-in-ball spawn
coalesce: One per point+generation; coalesce repeated countdown ticks
poolBudgetProposal: One marker per currently relevant point; avoid per-frame tick effect
lowFXMustRetain: Availability/remaining-time/status readable without color alone; no false available state
licenseNeeds: Own/approved icon and sound; third-party art must be licensed

trigger: Player's item slot changes Empty to Held after authoritative claim
localOrRemote: Local holder clear; nearby opponents only if game rules make item state public
confirmationRequirement: confirmed slot/ownership state
audio: Short acquire cue; don't confuse with activation
visual: Slot icon/name and held status
coalesce: Deduplicate by powerup instance+generation; no repeated event from replicated state
poolBudgetProposal: One HUD slot indication; short cue shares gameplay pool
lowFXMustRetain: Item held/empty state remains legible in lowFX and does not imply activation
licenseNeeds: Original icon/sound or approved source; record attribution if required

trigger: Single-slot magnet activation confirmed
localOrRemote: Local holder plus remote nearby players who need counterplay awareness
confirmationRequirement: authoritative active power and start/end time; activationId idempotent
audio: Short start cue; low-priority loop or none, never crowd warnings
visual: Clear, bounded magnetic field/status ring with remaining duration; non-gameplay decorations separate
haptic: Optional light tap only; disable always available
coalesce: One activation start/end pair per activationId; avoid repeated loop restarts
poolBudgetProposal: One active magnet visual per ball; one short audio; no per-target continuous audio
lowFXMustRetain: Opponent-readable active/status timer and range/relevant shape remain; lowFX may remove particles only
licenseNeeds: Original symbolic visuals/audio; avoid any imitation of iconic original effects; license each external asset

trigger: Magnet proposes nearby candidate to fly locally before claim commit
localOrRemote: Local player only; opponent gets nothing until claim result
confirmationRequirement: visual prediction only; no awarded volume until collect.confirmed
audio: No pickup reward; optionally one soft pull texture sound after coalescing
visual: Thin brief local path/ghost; canceled if claim rejected
coalesce: Batch by claim window and target; cap visual bursts; rejected claim stops immediately
poolBudgetProposal: Shares one magnet pull VFX pool; max few visible candidates proposed, not measured
lowFXMustRetain: Pending target cannot look like collected/confirmed; status/score remain ledger-owned
licenseNeeds: Any future path/particle assets require documented license; none created here

trigger: Single-slot rocket begins on valid Jump edge
localOrRemote: Local holder and nearby opponents with counterplay relevance
confirmationRequirement: authoritative activationId/start/end; one valid edge
audio: Short launch cue, no sustained loud loop
visual: Readable trail/status marker and remaining timer; no camera/FOV shake
haptic: Optional short gentle pulse; user can disable; no repeat pulse per frame
coalesce: One start/end pair; reject repeated held input; coalesce replicated duplicates
poolBudgetProposal: One trail per ball; reuse instead of emit-per-frame unbounded particles
lowFXMustRetain: Rocket active/expiry visible and readable without color; preserve rival threat clarity
licenseNeeds: Original effect design only; each actual audio/trail asset requires license record

trigger: Magnet/rocket ends
localOrRemote: Local holder and relevant nearby observers
confirmationRequirement: authoritative expiry/termination and cleanup; no local clock-only award
audio: Short quiet end cue only if not masked by warning
visual: Remove/settle active marker and show slot empty when confirmed
coalesce: One end per activationId, including KO/bank/cancel path
poolBudgetProposal: Reuse activation effect; no new allocation
lowFXMustRetain: Held/active/empty state and canceled-vs-expired outcome stay clear
licenseNeeds: Reuse approved source assets; no third-party asset unreviewed

trigger: Shared collision/size/protection state yields threat according to approved rule
localOrRemote: Target player's local client gets directional alert; remote threat target only
confirmationRequirement: derive from current shared confirmed state / fixed rule; never infer from random decoration
audio: Warning sound, highest-priority mix; throttle repeat but don't mute first/meaningful escalation
visual: Persistent direction/shape/label marker; not color-only; no forced camera movement
haptic: Optional light directional pattern only if device supports; may be fully disabled
coalesce: Hysteresis and rate-limit repeats; escalate on materially changed threat/attacker only
poolBudgetProposal: Reserve warning audio/UI slots; do not lose alert due to ambient pool pressure
lowFXMustRetain: A clear P0 warning and direction/status remain under lowFX; no paid cosmetic may cover/replace it
licenseNeeds: Unique UI/audio, cleared for commercial use and accessibility; avoid scary/high-intensity borrowed sounds

trigger: Player becomes protected or protection expires
localOrRemote: Protected player and nearby opponents if state affects eligibility
confirmationRequirement: authoritative life/protection state + end time
audio: No repeating loop; one short start/end state cue if necessary
visual: Distinct persistent protection shape/status ring; must not rely solely on color
haptic: None or one gentle start pulse, configurable/off
coalesce: One per state transition; no per-frame timer cue
poolBudgetProposal: Reuse persistent status slot; no particle stream required
lowFXMustRetain: Protection state/timer and attack eligibility must remain clear to players in lowFX
licenseNeeds: Original clear symbol; no misleading cosmetic override; register any font/icon license

trigger: Authoritative PvP contact resolves as push / hit but not KO
localOrRemote: Attacker and target local clients; other clients only sparse nearby summary
confirmationRequirement: confirmed collision outcome; local prediction may show neutral contact only
audio: Brief impact tone, attenuate/coalesce repeated contacts
visual: Brief localized impact marker; never camera shake/roll
haptic: Optional very light tap; no repeated haptics on contact spam
coalesce: By collision transaction/target cooldown; strongest event wins
poolBudgetProposal: One impact transient per local event window; share sound pool
lowFXMustRetain: Outcome (push vs KO) distinguishable in state/label; no false elimination
licenseNeeds: Original feedback; individually cleared SFX/VFX/haptic pattern

trigger: Authority commits KO transaction
localOrRemote: Victim/attacker local richer message; remote observers simplified
confirmationRequirement: confirmed single KO result; prevent duplicate event by transaction ID
audio: Short clear KO cue; no distressing blast or loud spam
visual: Explicit KO state/attacker result; stable fade/transition, no forced HMD motion
haptic: Optional gentle single pulse only; fully off-capable
coalesce: One per KO transaction; suppression of duplicates must not suppress state UI
poolBudgetProposal: Reserve one critical UI/audio event; no expensive screen/post effect
lowFXMustRetain: KO status, preserved banked score/lost unbanked state, respawn progress remain legible; no cosmetic substitution
licenseNeeds: Original/appropriately licensed feedback; never reuse original Katamari sounds or characters

trigger: Respawn transaction places player at safe point and starts protection
localOrRemote: Respawning player's client; remote state simplified
confirmationRequirement: confirmed respawn placement/life-state/protection start
audio: Quiet reset/return cue; no celebration for respawn protection
visual: Show active/life/protection status and safe-control return; transition is stable
coalesce: Once per life-generation; coalesce repeated reset signals
poolBudgetProposal: Reuse KO/respawn transition slot; no repeated overlay allocation
lowFXMustRetain: Life state, protection timer, and controls-restored state remain visible/readable
licenseNeeds: Original visual/audio only; any external asset listed in license manifest

trigger: Player enters currently active bank zone
localOrRemote: Local player and relevant nearby opponents
confirmationRequirement: authoritative active anchor/revision and local zone confirmation; entry alone is not a deposit
audio: Neutral proximity cue; no score-reward sound yet
visual: Show active deposit zone/eligible state and next anchor preview
coalesce: One per anchor revision/entry; gate dwell repeats
poolBudgetProposal: One persistent bank marker; no per-frame audio
lowFXMustRetain: Correct target and whether deposit is pending/eligible visible; don't imply points already banked
licenseNeeds: Own world marker/UI or approved licensed icons; no original-game UI

trigger: Player requests deposit and it awaits resolution
localOrRemote: Requesting player only; remote observers get no guessed score
confirmationRequirement: local pending request identity; ledger unchanged until commit
audio: Neutral pending sound only once, preferably silence
visual: Pending state/spinner with request; never animate final score as committed
coalesce: Deduplicate by bankRequestId; suppress retries
poolBudgetProposal: Reuse one pending UI slot per player
lowFXMustRetain: Pending cannot be confused with banked score; last confirmed score stays displayed
licenseNeeds: Use own UI assets/fonts or approved license; localization must be reviewed

trigger: Authority atomically commits deposit and growth reset
localOrRemote: Depositing player rich; remote observers summary/result only
confirmationRequirement: confirmed unique bankRequestId+commitSequence; not inferred from zone entry
audio: Short deposit success cue; merge small deposits, reserve P0 mix
visual: Confirmed score update and reset status; no giant blocking flash
coalesce: Exactly once per bankRequestId; coalesce visual number ticks, retain final total
poolBudgetProposal: One success cue/number animation; persistent total is not transient pool
lowFXMustRetain: Banked total, growth reset, and active/next bank state remain readable without effects
licenseNeeds: Original UI/audio; licenses and redistributable source documented per asset

trigger: Deposit request fails due to eligibility/state/cutoff
localOrRemote: Requesting player only
confirmationRequirement: explicit authority rejection; no success cue
audio: No reward cue; optional neutral invalid/cancel sound
visual: Show brief reason/status; preserve prior confirmed bank total
coalesce: Deduplicate by request ID/reason; stale rejects ignored
poolBudgetProposal: Reuse pending UI marker
lowFXMustRetain: Player can tell deposit failed and that total did not change, including lowFX
licenseNeeds: Original text/icon/audio; localization/font licenses if external

trigger: Player enters lobby join area and submits readiness request
localOrRemote: Local joining player; host/client sees roster only after confirmed roster state
confirmationRequirement: local entry may be provisional; confirmed unique roster membership for success feedback
audio: One quiet join acknowledgment only on confirmed join
visual: Roster/queue state; no accepted slot on trigger alone
coalesce: Deduplicate area enter/exit requests and same player session
poolBudgetProposal: One per-player join status UI entry; no individual nearby 3D effect
lowFXMustRetain: Joined/queued/rejected status and roster count remain clear
licenseNeeds: Original UI/sounds; any third-party font/icon tracked

trigger: Server/match state enters countdown or time changes materially
localOrRemote: All round participants and relevant lobby observers
confirmationRequirement: authoritative phase/end-time state; avoid per-second network ticks
audio: Sparse start and final-seconds cues; no spoken countdown required
visual: Persistent countdown numeral plus text/shape; show phase
haptic: None or one optional low pulse at threshold, fully disable
coalesce: Only phase start and selected thresholds; coalesce clock display client-side from end time
poolBudgetProposal: One shared countdown UI; no one-shot allocation per second
lowFXMustRetain: Phase/time and locked roster status survive lowFX and distinguish cancellation
licenseNeeds: Own UI/sound; any text font/audio license documented

trigger: Countdown/round cancels from roster or readiness failure
localOrRemote: Participants and lobby observers
confirmationRequirement: authoritative phase transition with reason where available
audio: Short neutral cancellation cue; no end-of-round win sound
visual: Explicit cancelled/return-to-lobby state and reason
coalesce: One per roundId/state revision
poolBudgetProposal: Reuse round status panel
lowFXMustRetain: Cancellation cannot look like match start or victory
licenseNeeds: Original UI/SFX assets with recorded rights

trigger: Match transitions to Playing after preparation checks
localOrRemote: Participants; observers may receive concise status
confirmationRequirement: authoritative roundId/phase transition; start only once
audio: Single start cue, volume capped; never continuous announcement
visual: Show map/round start and controls hint without obscuring play
coalesce: One per roundId; no duplicate on snapshot recovery
poolBudgetProposal: One start overlay/audio per client; release on timeout
lowFXMustRetain: Active match, roster and timer shown; lowFX retains rules/controls state
licenseNeeds: Original composition and UI; licensed/redistributable asset record

trigger: Confirmed/shared match end time reaches final warning window
localOrRemote: Participants
confirmationRequirement: authoritative end time/phase; timing derived locally from shared endpoint
audio: One or two capped reminder tones at fixed thresholds; do not spam
visual: Persistent remaining-time label and warning shape/text
coalesce: Threshold-only; skip duplicate/late warnings after recovery
poolBudgetProposal: Reserve critical countdown channel; no per-second events
lowFXMustRetain: Time-to-end and no-more-entry semantics remain legible without color/effects
licenseNeeds: Original UI/audio, documented source/rights

trigger: Authority transitions Playing to Settling and stops new gains
localOrRemote: Participants
confirmationRequirement: authoritative phase/cutoff; accepted transactions resolved by rules only
audio: Quiet phase-change cue; don't signal winner before result commit
visual: Show settling/no new claims status; pending outcomes remain distinct
coalesce: One per roundId/phase revision
poolBudgetProposal: Reuse phase status overlay
lowFXMustRetain: Cutoff and confirmed vs pending/rejected ledger outcome must remain clear; lowFX cannot affect judgeability
licenseNeeds: Own status UI; license font/icon/audio if external

trigger: Authority commits final result/rank/tie state
localOrRemote: Participants and lobby/results observers
confirmationRequirement: confirmed final ledger/result revision only
audio: Short result cue after commit; winning flourish stays local/short
visual: Final rank/tie and banked score; podium visuals bounded to result area
haptic: Optional gentle pulse; can disable; no repeated winner vibration
coalesce: One per result revision; one result presentation per roundId
poolBudgetProposal: One result UI panel and one bounded effect; no persistent particle buildup
lowFXMustRetain: Rank/tie/banked score and result availability remain readable; cosmetics cannot obscure warnings or alter rank
licenseNeeds: Original assets; third-party audio/font/icon license/reuse rights documented; no original game music

trigger: Round resets/players return to lobby and transient state cleans up
localOrRemote: All previous participants
confirmationRequirement: authoritative Resetting/Lobby phase and reset generation
audio: Optional low-level transition, not a reward cue
visual: Clear transient effects and restore lobby status; no forced teleport/camera effect
coalesce: Idempotent per reset generation; repeated reset events are no-ops
poolBudgetProposal: Release/reuse all transient pools; reset counts instrumented in future tests
lowFXMustRetain: Lobby/exit UI and restored state remain visible; reset cannot hide error/exit path
licenseNeeds: No new asset required; any transition asset licensed

trigger: Player previews/equips a cosmetic in lobby
localOrRemote: Local player primary; remote observes replicated selected cosmetic if permitted
confirmationRequirement: preview is local-only; selected cosmetic state must not imply entitlement unless confirmed by official entitlement
audio: No gameplay success sound; quiet UI navigation only
visual: Preview shows cosmetic at multiple sizes with threat/status layer separate; not gameplay screenshot
coalesce: Coalesce rapid preview selection; latest preview wins
poolBudgetProposal: Single local preview target; bounded podium/preview presentation
lowFXMustRetain: Threat ring, protection, score and opponent readability remain above cosmetics in all modes
licenseNeeds: Each cosmetic needs source, author, license, commercial/redistribution compatibility, entitlement boundary; no gameplay-affecting effect

trigger: User exits match/Station or recovery returns to lobby
localOrRemote: Local player and remote roster only if membership changes
confirmationRequirement: confirmed exit/reset state; user action remains available locally even during effect overload
audio: No sound required; never block exit
visual: Keep explicit exit control available; restore lobby/state indicators; no full-screen blocker
coalesce: No duplicate transition for same player-session/round state
poolBudgetProposal: No reserved transient allocation; state UI independent
lowFXMustRetain: Exit, respawn/recovery/cancel status and restored control state remain accessible under lowFX
licenseNeeds: Own UI text/icon; any fonts/accessibility assets require documented license
